rationale: Round 2 produced clearer quantification and an expert test of the no-closure option, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state still reject closures and forced redundancies, while management, investors, and the family still refuse to rule them out. The discussion is now circling around the same trade-off with firmer positions, so a structured intervention focused on hard numbers and scenario comparison is needed rather than more open-ended rounds.
